commentary.text: 90+6' Ermano Feliciani is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+5' Karol Linetty (Torino) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
90+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Parma.
90+3' The ball rebounds to Che Adams (Torino) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
90+2' The Torino players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

78' The Parma players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

74' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Karol Linetty (Torino). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
74' The corner from Karol Linetty (Torino) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Torino are awarded a corner kick.
71' Great teamplay by Torino as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

Vanja Milinkovic-Savic sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. The ball goes behind for a corner. Parma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

54' Neat passing move from Torino in order to create new attacking opportunities.

48' The Torino players are exchanging some short passes.

45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
44' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Torino.
43' Parma exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye.
41' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
40' Torino are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
39' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
36' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Zion Suzuki makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
35' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) takes the corner but it's cleared.
35' Parma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Parma have been awarded a corner kick.
34' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Parma force a corner. They send men into the box.
34' Torino seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
31' The ball possession at the moment is 63:37.

25' Torino control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
23' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman signals a throw-in for Parma.
22' Great teamplay by Parma as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
19' Torino can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

19' Che Adams (Torino) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the bottom right corner, but Zion Suzuki was alert and made an amazing save! Good work from Torino as they win a corner.
18' The Torino players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

13' Torino fail to score from a corner as Zion Suzuki (Parma) leaps to collect the ball.
13' The resulting set piece from Torino is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The linesman points to the corner flag, Torino are going to take it.

10' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Valentin Mihaila (Parma) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
9' The corner from Ivan Ilic (Torino) is hurriedly cleared.
9' Che Adams (Torino) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads it low towards the right side of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him. Now Torino have a corner.
8' Samuele Ricci (Torino) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
7' The Torino players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
4' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic blocks Valentin Mihaila (Parma)'s effort from the edge of the box.
2' Parma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
